frozen_rule: Art. LIX discipline: this corpus is frozen BEFORE any V1-vs-V2 comparison run. Queries are MECHANISM-level strings derived from problem facts (device + failure mode) — never title fragments, author names, DOIs or patent numbers of the targets. Ground-truth targets are documents the repository ALREADY knows are relevant from RECORDED history (R406 P13 novelty search: LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/P13/NOVELTY_SEARCH_R406; P04/P11 claim maps). No target identifier appears in any query. No tuning against this corpus is permitted after freeze.
v1_definition: RETRIEVAL_FABRIC_V1 = discovery_fabric/a2/retrieve.py::retrieve (Europe PMC primary + OpenAlex lane, cross-source dedup, top-5 evidence pool with abstract>=200 filter on the OpenAlex lane) — the exact legacy code path, byte-unchanged.
v2_definition: RETRIEVAL_FABRIC_V2 = discovery_fabric/retrieval_fabric::retrieve (multi-source open/free fabric: Europe PMC + OpenAlex as two nodes among scholarly graphs, DOI registrants, OA journal registry, repository aggregators, thesis lane, preprints, patents; canonical dedup with preserved provenance; lineage attribution; publication-status labeling; per-lane ranking).

problem.constraint: long-term in vivo accuracy without recalibration

problems.why: The P13 lesson: the decisive prior art was a 2018 DISSERTATION (Seaver, dual matched-die, common-mode drift subtraction) plus 1982-2023 PATENTS (dummy-element bridge). The V1 pipeline (Europe PMC + OpenAlex, journal-abstract evidence pool) structurally cannot surface either document class.

targets.provenance: R406 PA-1: Seaver 2018, University of Tennessee, trace.tennessee.edu
R406 PA-2: thermally compensated silicon pressure sensor (dummy-element bridge, 1982)
R406 PA-3: drift compensation for implanted capacitance-based pressure sensors

adversarial_properties: patent_claim_relevant_title_irrelevant (T2 title is 'Thermally compensated silicon pressure sensor' — the query never says 'thermally compensated')
terminology_differs_radically (query says 'dual matched sensor'; the art says 'dummy element', 'matched dies', 'biopressure')

problem.constraint: catalytic clearance of biofilm on indwelling surfaces

problems.why: Biomedical-domain control: V1 (Europe PMC + OpenAlex) SHOULD be strong here. Measures false-positive/noise expansion — if V2 adds noise without adding recall in a domain where V1 is strong, that is the honest cost of the fabric, reported not hidden.

problem.constraint: sub-milliwatt delivered power for an implantable shunt sensor

problems.why: Engineering-domain case: Europe PMC coverage is thin for ultrasonic power transfer engineering; cross-domain sources (patents, repositories, DOAJ engineering journals) materially change the search space. Measures cross-domain coverage expansion.

problem.constraint: proportional flow modulation under upstream pressure

problems.why: Mixed biomedical + patent-dense domain: both document classes matter for prior-art collision. The R405-recorded P11 claim map (US20250242099A1, vascular servovalve) is a known-relevant patent family.

targets.provenance: R405 P11 claim map: US20250242099A1 (servovalve-class art for implantable pressure-regulated flow)

noise_measurement.instrument: discovery_fabric.source_registry.query_relevance.adjudicate_record (the discovery pipeline's own per-record relevance adjudicator; >= 2 content-term overlap with the primary query)
noise_measurement.rule: A record in an evidence pool is NOISE when it fails adjudication against the problem's primary query. FP rate = noise / pool size, per fabric version. Both recall expansion AND FP-rate change are reported (acceptance criterion 13).
noise_measurement.class: ENGINEERING threshold per the query_relevance instrument's declared bands (Art. XXVII: declared, not invented)

acceptance_criteria.six_families: >= 6 materially different open/free source families queried successfully on the benchmark
acceptance_criteria.document_classes: Literature, patents, preprints, theses represented as distinct document classes
acceptance_criteria.failures_surfaced: Source failures and rate limits explicitly surfaced per run
acceptance_criteria.canonicalization: Duplicate records canonicalized without destroying source provenance
acceptance_criteria.lineage: Source lineage distinguishes genuine diversity from multiple indexes of the same record
acceptance_criteria.v2_unique: V2 retrieves relevant records absent from the V1 pipeline's evidence pool
acceptance_criteria.non_journal: At least one benchmark demonstrates discovery of a relevant non-journal source the old pipeline misses (the thesis + patent targets)
acceptance_criteria.genuine_expansion: Query expansion produces genuinely different retrieval terms (pinned by hermetic test)
acceptance_criteria.replayable: Retrieval replayable from a clean checkout (script + committed corpus + committed registry)
acceptance_criteria.no_rewrite: No existing evidence, historical record, or frozen artifact rewritten
acceptance_criteria.fp_reported: Both recall expansion and false-positive/noise expansion reported
acceptance_criteria.auditor_provenance: Machine-readable provenance sufficient for an independent auditor to reconstruct the discovery event
